# Draft:Pte. Albert Edward (Ellis) Needham

----
(Pte Albert Edward (Ellis)Needham)
Albert Edward Needham was born in East Retford,Nottinghamshire on the month of April 1892. As the 3rd oldest brother in the Needham family. Albert was included only in the 1901 census but no others because of this much of Albert's early life is very spaced out and this is likely why most records start appearing in the First World War such as Medal Roll Cards.Albert was a private in the King's Own Yorkshire Light Infantry 10Th Battalion.Albert Edward Needham was declared MIA(Missing In Action) on the 1st of July 1916 after being in the first lot of his Battalion to go over the top he is commerated at the Sturton Le Steeple War Memorial and Theipval war Memorial
